bangla_explanation: Strategy, স্থান, সময় আর cost ঠিক করার পর সব কিছু একটা planner-এ লিখে রাখতে হয়।
Planner দিয়ে strategy সাজানো যায়, আবার documentation আর record keeping-ও হয়।
CBLM-এর sample planner-এর তিনটা অংশ: Summary of the planner, Technical Competency Development Plan আর Certification।
Summary-তে দুই জায়গার approval-এর ঘর আছে: Principal আর Agency।
Plan অংশে প্রতিটা competency-র elements আর performance criteria লিখতে হয়; এগুলোই পরে evidence-এর ভিত্তি।

example.en: A welding Senior Instructor at a TTC fills the planner. He lists three welding units, the training centre, cost and months. His principal signs it.
example.bn: CBLM-এর sample-ও একজন welding instructor-এর planner।

short.prompt: What is a technical competency development planner? What are its parts?
short.modelAnswer:
A planner is helpful for setting up strategies, documentation and record keeping. The sample planner has three parts:
1. Summary of the planner: trainer details, competency, NTVQ level, strategy, training centre, cost, time frame and approvals.
2. Technical Competency Development Plan: competency, elements and performance criteria.
3. Certification: an industry person certifies the units achieved.
